subject: reading
title: The Bike Ride
about: Jake helps Mike when a stick jams his bike. Adds the Unit 2 sounds: magic e in a_e (Jake, lake, gate), i_e (Mike, bike, ride, fine) and o_e (spokes), and ee (green, free), on top of the short-vowel words, plus the tricky words we, they, he, you, are, blue, down and says. Decodable at CKLA Unit 2, so he can read it alone.
tip: Cold read first, then read it to him, then let him read it again; point out the magic e that makes bike and ride say their names.

passage.text:
Jake has a red bike.
Mike has a blue bike.
"We can ride to the lake," says Jake.

They ride past the green gate.
They ride down the hill.
Fast, fast, fast!

A stick gets stuck in Mike's spokes.
Mike's bike stops.
Jake stops to help.
He tugs the stick.
Pop!
It is free.

"You are a fine pal," says Mike.
They ride to the lake.
"What a fine ride!"

cards.note: Jake has the red bike; Mike has the blue one.

cards.q: Where do Jake and Mike ride to?
cards.note: Jake says they can ride to the lake.

cards.q: What gets stuck in Mike's spokes?
cards.note: A stick gets stuck in the spokes and the bike stops.

cards.q: What does Jake do when Mike's bike stops?
cards.note: Jake stops to help and tugs the stick free.
They ride past the gate and down the hill first; the stick comes later.

cards.q: Where are Jake and Mike at the end?
cards.note: They ride on to the lake at the end.

cards.q: How does Mike feel after Jake helps him?
cards.note: Mike calls Jake a fine pal, so he is glad.

cards.q: What is the lesson of the story?
cards.note: Jake stops to help, and that is what a good pal does.
Spokes are the thin rods that hold a bike wheel's rim.

cards.q: Which word is in the story?
cards.note: Gate is in the story; game and gale are look-alikes that are not.
